title: Automating AWS Agent Registry updates with push-based architecture
summary: This post shows how to keep the AWS Agent Registry current automatically. Using AWS CloudTrail, Amazon EventBridge, AWS Lambda, and AgentCore Identity, an event-driven pipeline detects MCP server changes and pushes updated tool metadata to the registry with no stored secrets, acr
reason: AWS blog how-to on wiring CloudTrail/EventBridge/Lambda to auto-sync Agent Registry metadata. It is an architecture tutorial, not a model release, research artifact, business event, policy action, or new OSS tool/framework launch.
